oneLiner.text: Nephritic: proteinuria below 3.5 g/day with RBC casts. Nephrotic: proteinuria ≥3.5 g/day without red blood cell casts.

caso.text: inflammatory damage to the glomerular basement membrane, leaking red blood cells and mild-to-moderate protein

evidence.quote: Nephritic syndrome results from inflammatory damage to the glomerular basement membrane, allowing red blood cells and mild-to-moderate protein to leak into the urine

caso.text: podocyte foot-process effacement without prominent glomerular inflammation

evidence.quote: Nephrotic syndrome reflects podocyte foot-process effacement without prominent glomerular inflammation

cells.text: Dysmorphic red blood cells and red blood cell casts

evidence.quote: dysmorphic red blood cells (acanthocytes) and red blood cell casts

cells.text: Fatty casts, oval fat bodies, Maltese crosses, without red blood cell casts

evidence.quote: Urinalysis reveals fatty casts, oval fat bodies, and Maltese crosses under polarised light, without red blood cell casts

bullets.text: Proteinuria cut-off: nephritic stays below 3.5 g/day; nephrotic is ≥3.5 g/day, urine protein-to-creatinine ratio ≥3.5 g/g

evidence.quote: Hallmark proteinuria is ≥3.5 g/day (urine protein-to-creatinine ratio ≥3.5 g/g)

bullets.text: Nephritic urine sediment: dysmorphic red blood cells (acanthocytes) and red blood cell casts, cola-coloured haematuria

evidence.quote: Urinalysis classically shows dysmorphic red blood cells (acanthocytes) and red blood cell casts, producing cola-coloured haematuria

bullets.text: Nephrotic urine sediment: fatty casts, oval fat bodies and Maltese crosses, without red blood cell casts

evidence.quote: Urinalysis reveals fatty casts, oval fat bodies, and Maltese crosses under polarised light, without red blood cell casts

bullets.text: Nephritic hallmarks: oliguria, azotaemia, hypertension; post-streptococcal low C3 at 2-4 weeks; IgA nephropathy within 1-3 days, normal complement; rapidly progressive crescents

evidence.quote: IgA nephropathy (synpharyngitic haematuria within 1-3 days, normal complement)
Use the mnemonic PHARAOH for nephritic features

bullets.text: Nephrotic hallmarks: severe hypoalbuminaemia (<3.0 g/dL), anasarca, hyperlipidaemia, antithrombin III loss with hypercoagulable renal vein thrombosis, encapsulated bacteria from immunoglobulin loss

evidence.quote: Urinary loss of antithrombin III creates a hypercoagulable state with risk of renal vein thrombosis
urinary loss of immunoglobulins increases susceptibility to encapsulated bacteria

bullets.text: Renal vein thrombosis risk especially in membranous nephropathy

evidence.quote: renal vein thrombosis (especially in membranous nephropathy)

nunca.text: Do not diagnose nephrotic syndrome on dipstick alone without quantifying proteinuria ≥3.5 g/day

evidence.quote: Do not diagnose nephrotic syndrome on dipstick alone without quantifying proteinuria ≥3.5 g/day

nunca.text: Do not overlook overlap: membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis and diffuse proliferative lupus nephritis can display both nephritic and nephrotic features

evidence.quote: membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis and diffuse proliferative lupus nephritis can display both nephritic and nephrotic features
